sam: "Proceed Carefully" :grimacing:

jorge: "Heat Responsibly"
maria: "Questionable Origins" :thinking_face:
noor: adding dramatic flair: "Pandora Lunch" :open_mouth:
dev-bot: poll created · react with emoji to vote
rachel: tallying at 4pm PT, drop last zingers now
sam: late entry: "Potential Regret" :flushed:
mel: my vote is "Potential Regret" for maximum honesty :joy:
jorge: "May Contain Life" :scream: (kidding?)
dev-bot: poll closed · winner: "Potential Regret" (4 votes) :trophy::confetti_ball:
rachel: Congrats @sam — claim your imaginary trophy and eternal office infamy. best 2-minute break ever :coffee:
